column7: Interface between Pack and our Charter Oranization. Completes annual re-chartering.
Leads the committee and is responsible for overall administration. Works closely with the Cubmaster or Scoutmaster to ensure the unit is running smoothly.
Records meeting minutes and keeps track of important documents. Manages communications, such as newsletters or emails, to the families.
Manages the pack/troop's finances, including budgeting, tracking expenses, dues collection and maintaining financial records.
Manages the recruitment of new scouts
Manages posting on social media accounts.
Works on ensuring a smooth onboarding process for new families. Works to make sure families continue to be successful and included in the pack and that they continue on through cross-over.
Organizes fundraising activities to support the pack/troop’s financial needs. Coordinates efforts to raise money for activities, events, and equipment.
Manages the popcorn fundraising campaign. Coordinates orders, distribution, and incentives related to the popcorn sale.

column7: Plans and coordinates outdoor activities, including camping trips, hikes, and special events. Works with the Cubmaster or Scoutmaster to schedule events that align with the scouting program.
Tracks scouts' progress and manages awards and rank advancements. Ensures all advancements are recorded and awards are ordered and distributed.
Ensures that leaders and committee members are properly trained. Coordinates with the district or council to organize training sessions and track leader training status.
